propertyEvents.locator: PDF page 1; the twelve quarters before Q2 2026: due and received dates, line 12 and penalties

propertyEvents.result: Twelve consecutive quarters, Q2 2023 to Q1 2026: every Form 941 received by its due date, every balance paid, every deposit by EFTPS. 1 penalty in the period: Q1 2024, FTD penalty $388.42 assessed June 10, 2024; abated August 19, 2024 for reasonable cause (the bank's EFTPS settlement error on the March 22 deposit). It was abated for reasonable cause, which neither the AEP test nor the First Time Abate test counts. For a 2026 quarter the IRS applies the Automatic Exemption from Penalty instead of First Time Abate. On the client's records the history qualifies; the reply asks for AEP on the $634.10, with reasonable cause as the fallback (AEP-01).
